review:
Chronos – Sands of Eternity is a time-themed Pragmatic Play slot built around oversized symbols. In the base game, wilds and high-paying symbols can land as normal 1×1 symbols or as 2×2 blocks carrying a random 1x–12x multiplier, and multipliers in the same win are added together.

Three, four or five scatters award 6, 8 or 10 free spins, and every scatter fills a meter. Each third scatter adds six spins and unlocks the next level, bringing 3×3 symbols and multipliers up to 24x. After the fourth retrigger only money and collect symbols can land, with collectors paying the money symbols on screen. The published RTP is 96.50%. It suits players who enjoy long, progressive bonus rounds.
